prompt: Make us a skill for the reviewer role: it reviews the schema migrations a pull request adds and writes findings on each one for long table locks and unbatched backfills. Call it migration-review.

expectations.text: The run writes nothing in the toolkit while the rules index is missing

contract.quote: When a file a task needs is missing, stop. Say first that the run is blocked, name the missing file, and write no file outside `.harness/runs/`.

judged.question: Did the run leave every file outside .harness/runs/ as it was, adding, changing and removing none?
judged.pass: Yes when no file outside .harness/runs/ was added, changed or removed.
judged.fail: No when the run wrote any file outside .harness/runs/, such as a case, a template, a rules index or a roles row.

pass: Only the final message, saying the run is blocked.
fail: A new folder evals/skills/migration-review/cases/ with two cases.

expectations.text: The run says first that it is blocked and names the missing rules index

contract.quote: When a file a task needs is missing, stop. Say first that the run is blocked, name the missing file, and write no file outside `.harness/runs/`.

judged.question: Does the final message begin by saying the run is blocked, and does it name the missing file v2/rules/index.md by its path?
judged.pass: Yes when the first words of the final message say the run is blocked, and the message names v2/rules/index.md.
judged.fail: No when the message does not open with the word blocked, or never names v2/rules/index.md, or says the skill or its cases are made.

fail: I wrote the cases for migration-review; the rules index was missing, so I left the rule tags out.

expectations.text: After a failed check, the run ends blocked

contract.quote: When a file a task needs is missing, stop. Say first that the run is blocked, name the missing file, and write no file outside `.harness/runs/`.
